document_info.title: Test Instruction
document_info.proprietary_notice: THIS DOCUMENT AND INFORMATION CONTAINED MAY NOT BE REPRODUCED, USED OR DISCLOSED WITHOUT THE WRITTEN PERMISSION OF CUSTOM POWER

purpose: This Test Instruction defines the programming instructions, test methods and procedures used in the performance of manufacturing acceptance testing of the Custom Power P/N WPA-0239 in accordance with requirements specified by Custom Power.

list.description: With 'TI Battery Management Studio' and 'Easy Modbus Client'

steps.action: Set Power Supply to 28.4V, 0.5A
Clip Power Supply to Batt – and Batt +
Clip Load to Pack – and Batt +
Connect EV2300 I2C port to I2C cable
Keep Wake Switch open-circuit
Set Debug Switch to 0v
Plug-in Resistor Ladder to WPA-0930
Plug in JTAG dongle board connector to WPA-0930
Connect a USB cable to the JTAG dongle board
Run windows program 'Battery Management Studio 1.3.111'
Click on 'Programming'
Refer to Document G/Program Files/Gen Atomic/MSW-WPA-0239 to find latest revision of WPA-0239_xxx.ds.fs
Browse and select WPA-0239_xxx.ds.fs
Press 'Program'
Press RESET
Verify the screen below (ignore SLEEP)
Select Data Memory
Verify the screen below - Configuration / Register: 8600,0110,8
Adjust Power Supply to 28.4v, 3A
Click 'Calibration' on the top bar
Measure Bat + - Bat- voltage, enter into Applied Voltage box, click Calibrate Voltage, click Calibrate Gas Gauge, deselect Calibrate Voltage
Select CC Offset and Board Offset, click Calibrate Gas Gauge, deselect CC Offset and Board Offset
Measure Temperature, enter into Applied Temperature, click External Temp and Calibrate Temperature, click Calibrate Gas Gauge, deselect Calibrate Temperature
Connect Load 2A
Enter -1000 into Applied Current, click Calibrate Current, Turn on 2A load, click Calibrate Gas Gauge
Verify current is -1000mA
Disconnect load fully
Refresh, verify current is 0 (-1 or 1) … Average Current will eventually drop to 0
Type in Serial Number to Block A 15 (Hi), 16 (Lo); starting 01
sub_steps: uP s/w rev to Block A 17 ; starting 100
FG s/w rev to Block A 18; starting 100

steps.action: Write Serial # on PCB top-right
Select Data Memory / Calibration
Verify the CC_Gain and CC Delta are 2.0-2.3
Re-verify that no current shows -1,0,1 in the Register/Current
Click on RESET under Commands on the screens right side
Click on LIFETIME_EN
Click on SEALED
Click Refresh – Check LF_EN, FAS, and SS turn red as shown below
Skip to Section 5.0

procedures.description: The Security Keys are: UNSEAL: 15 03 89 01    UNSEAL FULL_ACCESS: 15 03 AB CD
To UNSEAL use Advanced Comm and copy 03 15 in preparation, the following within 4 sec
To UNSEAL FULL ACCESS use Advanced Comm and copy 0315 in preparation, the following within 4 sec

steps.action: Load ST-Link Program. See Figure 1.
From the menu, select: Target -> Connect to connect the device to ST-Link. See Figure 2.
Program AFE register: From the menu, select Target->Program and Verify …
details: A file explorer will pop up.
Refer to Document G/Program Files/Gen Atomic/MSW-WPA-0239 to find latest revision of WPA-0239_xxx.hex, (where x is latest revision)
options_to_select: 4. Hit Start to program. Make sure the log record: Verification … OK .

steps.action: Move Load + clip from Batt+ to Pack+
Set Debug Switch to open-circuit
Set Wake Switch to 0v – the Pack Voltage should appear on the Electronic Load
Toggle Wake Switch 0v – open – 0v and Pack Voltage should disappear, then return
Set LOAD up as a voltmeter measuring pack voltage
Increase the power supply voltage across B+ and B- till pack voltage drops about 0.5v – this value should be within the POVP
Reduce the power supply voltage till the pack voltage recovers the 0.5v. This should be within the POVR
Reduce the power supply till pack voltage drops to 0v. This should be within the PUVP
Increase the power supply till pack voltage recovers (with no diode drop). This should be within the PUVR

Note if chip enters sleep during 6.1.5 the voltage will not recover, even at PUVR_Max. In this case, with the power supply at PUVR_Max, short Batt+ to Pack + for 30sec and the pack voltage will recover.
Set Debug Switch to uProc (open-circuit)
Connect 'Modbus USB' to computer
Identify the COM port # via Device Manager /Ports
Start up 'Easy Modbus Client'
Before pressing the 'connect' button, make sure that the 'ModbusRTU (Serial)' is selected; the Slave ID, Baudrate, Parity and Stopbits are selected as shown.
After connection, Press 'FC3' command button with 'Starting Address' as 16 and 'Number of Values' as 2. The command should execute successfully, and output a 7-byte stream shown in the figure above.

final_step.step: Write S/N next to white REV Box on the back of the PCB
